title: Negative-forward caplet model admissibility
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. A caplet pays N*accrual*max(L-K,0) at time1. In modelN, L is normal with meanF and standard deviation normal_vol*sqrt(T). In modelS, L+shift is lognormal with forward F+shift and annual lognormal volatility sigma. Discounting is deterministic and independent. Return both model prices, the normal-model derivative with respect to a +1bp change in F, and whether ordinary unshifted Black pricing is mathematically admissible for these F,K.

outputs.name: normal_forward_pv01
outputs.description: First-order signed PV change for +1bp forward.

outputs.name: unshifted_black_admissible
outputs.description: Is the usual log(F/K) Black formula applicable?

instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary. Return JSON with question_id and answers, where answers maps every output name to its typed value. Numeric arrays must follow the specified order.
